findings.independentCheck: v2 proofSchema.rule: 'Every finding at T1+ carries exactly one sealed proof.' noProofNoSeal is vacuously true when findings=[]. T1 retains only FindingProofs. A clean pass has zero findings ⇒ zero proofs. Product gates on pass. Gap is real.
findings.note: This is a framing error in v2 that A1-RT-01 did not catch: I fixed relationship findings among positive findings and still designed around findings as the unit of proof.

findings.detail: Anchors and digests are commitments. Verifiable later requires witness bodies or authenticated membership/non-membership material. large-function with only span hash fails the product's 'checkable later' constraint.
Rule-declared findingShape is producer self-attestation. Host-owned ProofObligationId is required for gate-authoritative rules.
truncation=true under a T1-complete promise is a contradiction; residualDigest cannot stand in for omitted witness data when the claim is about a complete set.
Default T1 that writes source-derived structures recreates V1/V2 risk. Pre-write storage choice and measurement remain required; disclosure alone is not consent.
GC of proofs under retained Runs conflicts with pinning. Need append-only availability ledger + pin semantics.
Taxonomy incomplete: metric, complete-set, policy/baseline, external observation. Blast radius is not one path.
T2 input bytes ≠ attestation-grade replay without executable closure.
Prose conformance is not a contract. v3 needs executable goldens.

reframe1_unitOfProof.detail: Proof attaches to evaluation (match or no-match), not only to findings. Also policy/baseline/waiver steps. This is the minimum repair for B-RTV2-01 and is stronger than patching FindingProof alone.

reframe2_negativeIsHard.detail: No-match requires subject-set commitment + predicate identity + coverage sufficiency. Correct inversion: clean runs are the expensive proof case. v1/v2 size intuition was inverted.

strengths: Aligns with sealed content-addressed facts + conditional determinism
Avoids storing redundant proof blobs when regeneration is sound
Puts retention clock primarily on irreducible human display bytes

limitsAndBlockers.title: Does not fully dissolve V10 / V1
limitsAndBlockers.detail: Retained fact partitions are still source-derived (identifiers, structure, sometimes string literals). U3 PII can live in facts without source bytes. Minimisation improves; it is not 'no user content retained'.

limitsAndBlockers.title: Recomputation is not frozen attestation (RQ-3)
limitsAndBlockers.detail: An auditor who needs evidence frozen at decision time cannot accept pure on-demand regeneration unless regeneration is bit-identical and the full toolchain+ruleset is pinned (B-RTV2-08). Default mode vs attestation mode must split: recomputable default; stored EvaluationProof graph for attestation opt-in.

limitsAndBlockers.title: Fact-partition durability becomes the load-bearing copy
limitsAndBlockers.detail: If facts are pinned for retained Runs, size/privacy measurement moves to fact storage (same measurement debt as v2 proofs). Purging facts destroys explainability — must be first-class disclosure and inventory.

limitsAndBlockers.title: Still needs EvaluationProof schema even if proofs are regenerated
limitsAndBlockers.detail: On-demand regeneration produces a proof object at query time; the *obligation graph* (which evaluations, which commitments) must still be sealed at Run time so consumers know what must regenerate. SealedRun should carry EvaluationManifest (identities + digests), not empty.

Pre-write storage root refusal (TM V2) + inventory before first durable write
Executable schema + independent verifier goldens including clean-pass counterexample RTV2-CE-01
Truncate/exhaustion → indeterminate or narrower claim; never T1-complete with truncation=true
shouldNot: Treat T1-excerpt or v2 FindingProof-only as sealable default
Claim V10 is fully dissolved while fact partitions retain identifiers without privacy class and inventory
